newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour sees one-off windfall tax on utilties.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour sees one-off windfall tax on utilties.

text.p: Labour's economics spokesman, Gordon Brown, reaffirmed on Monday his determination to tax the windfall profits of Britain's privatised utilties if his party wins the coming election.
In a keynote economic speech, Brown said the levy was an illustration of Labour's commitment to a fair tax system.

"As I have made clear, this is a one-off measure which affects only the privatised utilities. I can confirm that the levy will be introduced in a first Labour budget. The details of the windfall tax will be announced after we have consulted the regulators in government," Brown said.
